in_hebrew.name: Blaise
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Blaise הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'blasare', meaning 'to lick', likely due to the association of the saint's miraculous powers with healing sores or wounds. Blaise is most famously known as the patron saint of those suffering from throat ailments and those afflicted with physical wounds.
